verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a native bulk-action capability, such as multi-select bulk edit or mass update across issues or accounts. Bulk work is only implied through the programmatic API that can 'take action on data', the MCP server that lets AI tools 'read and update issues, accounts, and contacts', and triggers/automations that run workflows across incoming issues. These would let a user script or agent-drive bulk changes as a workaround. Missing for 10: a documented native bulk select/edit feature, bulk API endpoints, agent-driven batch actions across many items, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
